title: Air Force Veterans Abducted By Aliens Reunite 50 Years Later [EMOTIONAL]
description:
In 1977, two Air Force security policemen guarding nuclear missiles at Ellsworth Air Force Base encountered a massive craft, non-human beings, and lost nine hours of time. The military separated them. One was discharged. The other spent 47 years searching for his partner.

We found him.

This is the story of Mario Woods and Michael Johnson: the Ellsworth AFB incident, the reunion, and the first-ever dual hypnotic regression revealing what both men saw on the craft that night.

GUESTS:
Mario Woods - Former USAF Security Policeman, 44th Missile Security Squadron, Ellsworth AFB
Michael Johnson - Former USAF Security Policeman, 44th Missile Security Squadron, Ellsworth AFB
Yvonne Smith - Hypnotic Regression Therapist (40+ years)
Ammar Kandil - Co-Producer, Co-Founder of Yes Theory
